decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to focus specifically on backpacks rather than accessories, camping tools, or clothing. My consideration set includes a range of options from lightweight daypacks (ZOMAKE) to large expedition packs (Mardingtop) and specialized cooler packs (SEEHONOR). I chose the KAILAS 28L Hiking Backpack as my final purchase because it offers a great balance of technical features, including a lightweight internal frame and ventilated suspension, which reviews compare favorably to high-end brands like Osprey, making it a high-value choice for serious hiking at a $69.99 price point.
